_comment: Virtual ad banners overlaid on top of convenience_store.glb (the GLB itself has no ad creative). Positions are hand-placed in the store's world coordinates (see backend/data/store_layout.json store_bounds) to test the 'bonus' ask: does placement change how much attention an ad captures? Edit freely - these are NOT derived from the GLB.

ad_slots.description: Promotional banner - tests a high-traffic endcap placement (directly in the shopper's forward view from spawn, right above the cereal aisle) against a low-traffic back-corner placement.
